{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
refunded_mask = data['status'] == 'refunded'
data_clean = data[~(qa_mask | refunded_mask)]

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rate difference within each group
stratified_rates = data_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')
stratified_rates = stratified_rates.rename(columns={'email': 'email_rate', 'paid_search': 'paid_search_rate'})
stratified_rates['effect'] = stratified_rates['email_rate'] - stratified_rates['paid_search_rate']

# Compute weights based on the distribution of segments in the email group
email_segment_counts = data_clean[data_clean['channel'] == 'email']['customer_segment'].value_counts()
total_segment_counts = data_clean['customer_segment'].value_counts()
weights = email_segment_counts / total_segment_counts

# Extract and print the exact values used in evidence
loyal_effect = stratified_rates['effect']['loyal']
new_effect = stratified_rates['effect']['new']
returning_effect = stratified_rates['effect']['returning']
loyal_weight = weights['loyal']
new_weight = weights['new']
returning_weight = weights['returning']
weighted_effect = (stratified_rates['effect'] * weights).sum()

# Print each value with 4 decimal places as they will appear in evidence
print(f"{loyal_effect:.4f}")
print(f"{new_effect:.4f}")
print(f"{returning_effect:.4f}")
print(f"{loyal_weight:.4f}")
print(f"{new_weight:.4f}")
print(f"{returning_weight:.4f}")
print(f"{weighted_effect:.4f}")

# Return for submission
weighted_effect"}
